description: Full Yahtzee rules — 5 dice, 3 rolls, all 13 scoring categories, upper-section bonus, and total score.

faqs.a: Ones through Sixes, Three of a Kind, Four of a Kind, Full House, Small/Large Straight, Yahtzee, and Chance.
Tap dice to hold them between rolls — held dice keep their value when you roll again.
You get 3 rolls per turn. After rolling, pick an empty category to score your dice into.
Score 63+ in the upper section (Ones–Sixes) to earn a 35-point bonus.
faqs.q: What is the upper section bonus?

howto: Press Roll Dice (3 rolls per turn).
Tap dice to hold the ones you like.
Pick an empty category to score the dice.
Fill all 13 categories — highest total wins!
title: Yahtzee Dice Game
